justification: Contributes Dendron, behaviour trees as explicit control-flow scaffolding fixing what an LM agent does next; argued as a unifying framework and shown through three built demos, with no measured validation.

Headline artefact is a five-stage pipeline plus six-dimension schema for measuring paradigm behaviour (20% omission detection, 30% redundant tool calls); evidence is four case studies from real deployment logs of a production system.
RF-Agent's claim is MCTS over candidate reward functions, i.e. expansion and selection shaping the search; evidence is lab experiments on 17 low-level control tasks, not deployed use.

Prime Agent is a harness for long-horizon evaluation that standardises execution and accounting so harness failures do not read as model failures; validated by lab benchmarks (ARC-AGI-3, coding). Runner-up: self_evolution.
Agent-R1 is an agentic-RL substrate that trains the agent on its own step-level rollouts, an outer loop changing the agent between episodes; the abstract argues the design and reports no evaluation.
The belief state exists to compress unbounded history into a near-constant context read back by the policy, so it is context management; evidence is lab gains on embodied benchmarks (+14.5%, +5.3%).

Contribution is the coordination and routing arrangement itself (inter-agent communication, payload referencing, orchestration bypass); evidence is handcrafted enterprise benchmark scenarios run in the lab, not a deployment.

Reflexion's object is the correction: verbal self-reflection on task feedback is stored and fed back so the next attempt is rewritten; evidence is lab benchmarks (91% pass@1 on HumanEval) plus ablations.

ReHAC trains a policy that decides when the loop must defer to a human rather than proceed unaided; evidence is lab experiments contrasting real and simulated collaboration scenarios, not a fielded system.

AndroidArena is the instrument: an environment, benchmark and adaptive metrics plus a failure-capability taxonomy (understanding, reasoning, exploration, reflection); agents are measured in a lab setting.

The claim is the generate-evaluate-refine loop that rewrites designs from FEM numerical feedback (an off-the-shelf checker); evidence is lab truss experiments varying temperature and model size against NSGA-II.
LATS's contribution is Monte Carlo Tree Search with LM value functions to expand and select among candidate continuations; evidence is lab benchmarks (HumanEval 92.7%, WebShop).
ReConcile's claim is the arrangement itself: a round-table of diverse LLM agents, a discussion prompt format and confidence-weighted voting; evidence is lab results on seven benchmarks.
HiAgent manages in-trial working memory by chunking history into subgoals and replacing past pairs with summaries so context stays readable; evidence is lab results on five long-horizon tasks.

AutoFlow generates the natural-language workflow that fixes the agent's procedure, i.e. what it does next; evidence is lab experiments comparing fine-tuning-based and in-context generation, no named benchmark or field use.

SPP's contribution is role arrangement: dynamically identifying personas and running multi-turn self-collaboration between them; evidence is lab results on three named tasks and a model-size comparison.

AgentMonitor audits each proposed action against a safety boundary and halts unsafe ones, a pre-execution gate with escalation to human reviewers; evidence is a prototype exercised on a battery of AutoGPT tests.

Pre-Act builds a multi-step execution plan with reasoning and refines it after each step, determining the next action; evidence is lab turn-level and end-to-end scores on the Almita dataset plus fine-tuning runs.

The finding is that a ReAct agent never re-checks whether an action may proceed, and the mitigation is a reflection step that reassesses action safety before execution; evidence is attack-versus-baseline lab experiments.
Think-on-Graph's mechanism is iterative beam search over knowledge-graph paths, expanding and pruning candidate reasoning chains; evidence is lab results with SOTA on 6 of 9 datasets.

The novel piece is Additional Opinions, supervised learners feeding action choices into the Auto-GPT decision step; evidence is lab benchmarks (WebShop, ALFWorld) with ablations. Runner-up: loop_evaluation_and_diagnosis.
KnowAgent constrains the action path during planning with an action knowledge base to curb planning hallucination, i.e. what the loop does next; evidence is lab results on HotpotQA and ALFWorld.

A-HMAD's contribution is the debate arrangement: heterogeneous role assignment, dynamic routing of which agent speaks, and a learned consensus weighting; evidence is lab results on six benchmarks with ablations.

ReSpAct's mechanism decides when the loop must stop and ask the user (clarify goals, resolve failures) rather than proceed unaided; evidence is lab benchmarks MultiWOZ, ALFWorld and WebShop. Runner-up: planning_and_control_flow.

RISE is an outer loop that fine-tunes the model on its own multi-turn attempts so it learns to correct itself, changing the agent between episodes; evidence is lab math-reasoning experiments across three model families.
